items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Interviewer asks: 'Are those the ones with Crosby that Bix and Trumbauer kind of chase choruses on 'You Took Advantage of Me.' Did you do that arrangement?' Interviewee responds: 'No, no. Tommy Satterfield, he was in the band then.'

ctx.x: But anyway, there's Old Man River, Lonely Melody." We got down to Camden and made a few down there.
Are those the ones with Crosby that Bix and Trumbauer kind of chase choruses on 'You Took Advantage of Me.' Did you do that arrangement?
No, no. Tommy Satterfield, he was in the band then. Very fine arranger, but he didn't stay too long, but then after he left they got Lenny Hayden.
